attestation_kind: SELF-ATTESTATION (producer assertion; not third-party validation, not authorization)
cisa_common_form_note: Designed as an ADDENDUM to the CISA Secure Software Attestation Common Form, not the form itself.

practices.practice: Define security requirements for software development
practices.producer_statement: CNSA 2.0 strict is the enforced baseline: ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 mandatory, allowlists deny by default, production fail-closed gates refuse downgrades.

practices.gap_and_plan: Formal security roles staffing/training is organizational work; tracked in SAR POA&M.
practices.producer_statement: In-repo roles exist (AO/ISSO/custodian in OSCAL SSP; two-person rule + custodian quorum in code), but no formal staffing or training program exists outside the repository.

practices.practice: Implement supporting toolchains and secure environments
practices.producer_statement: Pinned hashed dependencies, offline CVE/OSV scanning, Bandit SAST gate in CI, reproducible-build verification, air-gap-capable operation with no network calls in gates.

practices.practice: Define and use criteria for software security checks
practices.producer_statement: Deployment verifier (79+ checks), CNSA-2027 readiness gate, parser fuzz gates, KAT suites, and Bandit medium+ gate define release criteria; failures block (fail-closed, exit nonzero).

practices.gap_and_plan: Hosting-platform access controls must be evidenced by the hosting owner.
practices.practice: Protect all forms of code from unauthorized access/tampering
practices.producer_statement: Release integrity is cryptographic (TUF 4-role + manifest dual signatures, SBOM/CBOM ML-DSA-87 seals). Repository-hosting access controls (branch protection, reviewer rules) live outside this repo and are not asserted here.

practices.practice: Provide a mechanism for verifying software release integrity
practices.producer_statement: Every release artifact ships detached ML-DSA-87 signatures with colocated trust anchors plus SHA-512/SHA3-512 manifests; verification is offline and scripted.

practices.practice: Archive and protect each software release
practices.producer_statement: Reproducible-build receipts, signed SBOM/CBOM, and SLSA provenance stubs are retained per release in compliance_reports/.

practices.practice: Design software to meet security requirements / mitigate risk
practices.producer_statement: Documented threat model and audit report drive design; fail-closed defaults, authenticated handshake transcript binding, memory-safe data plane in Rust.

Vetted primitives only (liboqs, libsodium, cryptography); no custom ciphers. The one custom combiner (hybrid_combine_v2) is length-framed, transcript-bound, KAT-pinned, and documented as custom (X-Wing combiner lessons applied).

practices.practice: Create software with secure settings by default
practices.producer_statement: Deny-by-default: plaintext refused, unverified TOFU refused, software fallback refused in production, strictest caps pre-allocation. Every bypass requires explicit operator opt-in.

practices.practice: Review human-readable code and test executable code
practices.producer_statement: Parser fuzz gates (26), KAT suites, live two-terminal handshake proofs, 290+ gate tests, Bandit SAST, adversarial suites; defects fixed with regression locks (e.g., twins-parity guard).

practices.gap_and_plan: Record toolchain versions/hashes per release; tracked in SAR POA&M.
practices.producer_statement: Rust release profile hardened (lto, single codegen unit, stripped, panic=abort); Python runs without hardening flags audit. Toolchain provenance beyond reproducible-build receipts is not yet recorded.
Offline CVE scanning of pinned dependencies, 63-finding remediation battery with regression locks, fail-closed decaps/fault counters with alerting thresholds.

practices.gap_and_plan: Publish SECURITY.md with contact + SLA; tracked in SAR POA&M.
practices.producer_statement: No SECURITY.md contact or coordinated-disclosure policy ships with the repo; incidents are audit-logged with incident IDs and POA&M items track remediation programs.

product: Secure P2P Sovereign Communications Engine v2.0.0-CNSA2-2027
